rule.text: README section 4: unit = importer-selected raw artefact (one L1 row), stratum = the L1 row's arm key; about 5 per stratum (k raised from 5 until the quotas reach 30), all units when fewer than 30; above 300 the quotas are reduced proportionally (max(1, floor(q*300/total))) and the rest is given one at a time in sorted stratum order; per stratum the sorted labels are drawn with random.Random('20261011:precheck:<source>:<part>:<stratum>').sample
